extraction.title: Optimize spans buffer insertion with eviction during insert
extraction.head: performance-enhancement-complete

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as moving the spans buffer from Redis sets to sorted sets (ZADD/ZSCAN) scored by end_timestamp_precise, with Lua eviction via zpopmin above 1,000 spans per segment. Also adds OptimizedCursorPaginator with negative-offset support for audit logs and updates span test fixtures. Confidence score of 1/5, citing a missing OptimizedCursorPaginator class, unsafe negative-offset handling in paginator.py, and inconsistent eviction between the Python and Lua code in buffer.py. Reviewed 9 files, 3 comments.
logic: "OptimizedCursorPaginator" is imported but does not exist in the codebase - this will cause ImportError at runtime
Says the enable_advanced_features argument passed to the paginator is not supported by the paginator interface, and suggests checking the self.paginate method signature.
logic: Direct dictionary access to end_timestamp_precise will raise KeyError if the field is missing; suggests using .get() with a default value for backward compatibility.
